requirements_summary: Workload: in-app chat integrated into customer support flow; bursty traffic during user onboarding and marketing pushes.
Latency target: p95 < 750ms for short-turn chat messages (<=256 tokens).
Throughput target: baseline 20–50 rps, bursts to 100–200 rps for short windows (30–120s).
Cost sensitivity: moderate — prefer pay-as-you-go but need predictable throttles to avoid runaway spend.
Model preferences: open models acceptable; may accept quantized variants for cost savings if latency stays reasonable.
Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to smaller model variant or degraded response (shorter reply) rather than hard 429s.
Rate-limiting specifics desired: per-API-key concurrency cap, burst tokens per minute, headroom for short-term spikes, circuit-breaker guidance.
Retries: need recommended client SDK backoff (jittered exponential) with max-retries guidance to avoid stampeding herds.
Observability: desire token-level cost and latency breakdown per request; alerts for sustained 429 rates.
Security/compliance: require SSO for console, audit logs for API keys, retention controls for PII in logs (tbd).
